blocking_finding.title: generalized no-write/no-ship node still receives the legacy APPROVE GATE / MERGE AUTHORITY ship instructions
blocking_finding.root_cause: the FLY-47 checkpoint-injection loop skips brainstorm/approve_to_ship for isQaRunner only; there is no isGeneralizedExecution skip, so with checkpoints enabled those blocks are appended after the generalized capability lines
blocking_finding.failure_scenario: flywheel project runs with brainstorm + approve_to_ship checkpoints ENABLED. A tpl_research_light 'research' node (generic, no-write, no-ship, completion_route=no_code) is dispatched. Its prompt then contains BOTH 'Do not request ship approval or ship/merge a PR.' AND 'APPROVE GATE (MANDATORY — do NOT skip)' + 'complete --route needs_review' + MERGE AUTHORITY + verify-approval + ':cool:'. Contradictory instructions break capability isolation and can drive a no-ship node toward a ship/merge path or a wrong terminal state.
